_comment: Example Codex hooks.json registration for the Menhir Codex TurnEvidence producer. Merge the UserPromptSubmit block into your Codex hooks.json (e.g. C:/Users/<you>/IdeaProjects/.codex/hooks.json). Codex pipes the UserPromptSubmit event JSON to the script on stdin; the script POSTs only triage candidates and fails open. Use an absolute python path (any Python 3; the script is stdlib-only) and an absolute path to the producer.
